response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) AS average_count, SUM(type_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.type_count, tc.type_count * 1.0 / totals.total_count AS share_of_total, tc.type_count - totals.average_count AS count_above_average FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.average_count IS NOT NULL AND tc.type_count > totals.average_count;
